verdict.rationale: Airweave's documented AI capability is agentic search: an agent iteratively searches synced data and returns a result set. That is retrieval for downstream agents, not AI-generated insights or suggestions shown inside the product. The founder also describes it as a developer building block, which adds no credit, so the support is adjacent only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
